ACCEPTANCE_733.use_when: Running the remaining #733 hosted gates (G1, G2, AC17, G3, R0) on a throwaway no-route Worker against a separate Supabase project.
ACCEPTANCE_733.escalate_when: A failing check stops that phase and records `false`; exit is non-zero. Fix or report, do not hand-edit state.
never: Never run `wrangler deploy`/`secret`/`delete` against `noema-gateway`, or use `deploy-stage0.sh` for this.
Never put the production Supabase project in `acceptance.env`.
Never paste keys or tokens in chat or on a command line; the wizard reads them hidden.
Never skip teardown; the receipt is pinned to a version id and needs no live Worker.
